_comment: Mock C - Malformed/Adversarial. INTENTIONALLY INVALID. Tests whether Agents 5-7 reject or safely flag this claim rather than trusting the Comparison table at face value. Defects, deliberately present: (1) evidence = [] despite a specific numeric performance claim, (2) dataset = '' instead of null (violates the null-not-empty-string rule), (3) confidence = 'high' despite zero supporting evidence, (4) a 99% accuracy figure with no source_text anywhere to back it. This is specifically designed to test whether the verification layer does real work, not just passthrough trust.
